quotes.text: PBIP is the door, not the destination. It gives you per component version control, but it doesn't tell the people holding the steering wheel how to drive.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Sharp framing that PBIP enables version control but not team discipline.

quotes.text: So the practical approach is this map reviews strictness to impact. A single quick approval is fine for cosmetic or text tweaks.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Actionable rule for scaling pull request approvals to the risk of a change.

quotes.text: Instead of relying strictly on human reviewers to notice formatting gaps, weak naming, or missing descriptions, you let automation scan every PR before approval even hits the table.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Explains the division of labour between automated checks and human reviewers.

quotes.text: Governance that actually works is governance that feels like guardrails on a highway. They don't slow you down, they just make sure your car doesn't leave the road.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Memorable image of governance without bureaucracy.

quotes.text: Start with a handful of checks that deliver the most value, then expand as your team matures.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Pragmatic advice for introducing automated validation.

takeaways: PBIP splits reports and semantic models into text files so Git can show every change, but it does not fix team workflow on its own.
Scale pull request approvals to impact and let GitHub Actions run Tabular Editor, PowerShell and REST API checks so obvious mistakes never reach review.
Wire merges into deployment pipelines with service principals, keeping their limits on credentials, dataflows and item counts in mind.
hook: Five developers editing the same Power BI model is a recipe for chaos, even with PBIP. This episode is for BI teams and leads who want every change traceable: pull request approvals scaled to impact, automated checks with GitHub Actions and deployment pipelines that promote content from dev to production without manual clicks.
